### Covenant Blessings
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/covenant-blessings
Passage: Leviticus 26:1-13
Points:
- Earthly blessings under the Mosaic covenant gave God's people a foretaste of the world to come.
- True covenant faithfulness meant striving toward obedience and repenting when failing, looking ahead to the Messiah.
- God promised tangible community blessings including harvest abundance, safety, and peace from enemies.
- The crescendo of all covenant promises is the Lord's personal dwelling and walking among His people.
- Christians pursue obedience not to earn salvation, but out of gratitude for Christ's perfect covenant-keeping.
